correctness.rationale: Written proof excludes at most three colors for connected nonbipartite cubic graphs. The finite four-color census reduces exactly to 36 permitted local templates and completely enumerates 84 colorings with one root color fixed, hence 336 named and 14 unordered. Two independently constructed labeled Coxeter models and complete search algorithms agree. The 14 candidate 4-sets are precisely all diameter-four 4-cliques, and each occurs in six root-fixed assignments, determining one partition. Explicit rotation/reflection maps prove transitivity. Source programs and expected outputs supplied for replay.

value.rationale: The 28-vertex Coxeter graph is canonical (cubic, symmetric, girth seven). A precise optimal partition census for the strong odd coloring invariant, not previously implied by known chromatic bounds, reveals 14 rigid solutions in one symmetry orbit and a structural bijection with the graph’s diameter-four cliques. It separates neighborhood-parity coloring from ordinary cubic three-colorability and motivates comparisons on other symmetric cages. This is mathematically motivated finite structural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
